profile.headline: SDE @ AWS | ECE PhD @ UIUC | Ex iManage, ADSC (Singapore)
profile.summary:
I love building systems that work at scale and experimenting with new ways AI can solve real problems.

At AWS, I build agentic AI applications and have spent the past 4 years designing and operating large scale distributed systems with strict guarantees. 

Before that, I spent a decade in research -- a PhD at UIUC in probabilistic modeling and cybersecurity risk assessment, and earlier work at ADSC (Singapore) building wireless sensor networks and studying smart grid trustworthiness.

I'm happiest when I'm working on hard problems that also teach me something fundamental, whether that's agentic search, Monte Carlo simulations, or how a legacy codebase actually works under the hood.
